name: Batrachognathus
sum: Small anurognathid from the Late Jurassic Karabastau Formation of Kazakhstan.
wsnote: 50–75 cm; body mass about 40 g (specimens may not be adults).
material: Incomplete, disarticulated skeleton: skull fragments, jaws, vertebrae, ribs, legs and wing bones.
biology: Insectivore with a short, very wide mouth and recurved conical teeth, catching insects in flight.
author: Riabinin 1948

species.name: Batrachognathus volans
species.author: Riabinin 1948
